name: How does zoning coordination affect construction cost later?

mainEntity.name: How does early ADU zoning coordination reduce construction cost later in Los Angeles-area projects?
mainEntity.text: How does early ADU zoning coordination reduce construction cost later in Los Angeles-area projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early zoning coordination saves money because it identifies problems before the design is locked and the permit package is assembled. If a plan is too large, too close to a property line, or placed in the wrong part of the lot, the correction usually affects more than one drawing. It may change the foundation, roof, stairs, utility routes, and site improvements. That is why zoning should be treated as a cost-control step, not just an approval step. A feasibility review can also uncover whether a conversion or smaller detached unit will deliver the same functional result at lower cost. In many projects, the cheapest ADU is the one that fits the site with the fewest exceptions and revisions. The earlier the coordination happens, the easier it is to keep the project within budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Early zoning coordination lowers cost by preventing redesign, permit revisions, and avoidable site changes. It can also reveal when a smaller, simpler, or conversion-based ADU will be cheaper than the owner’s first idea.
